args.title: Saltmarsh Foods Newsletter Summary – Retail Returns Logistics
args.body:
- Newsletter: This week's Saltmarsh Foods newsletter covers "Retail returns logistics," linking to an article and promoting a related webinar.
- Article: Apparel return rates hit 24%; consolidating returns into dedicated handling hubs cut processing costs by about 20%.
- Companion piece: Reselling returned apparel within 10 days preserved most of its original margin, reinforcing the case for faster return-to-resale cycles.
